x: Bring your phone number from another carrier (mobile number portability, MNP). Apply online for free, or at a shop. How switching works Important Do not cancel your current contract before you switch. If you cancel first, your phone number is lost and cannot be brought to Kumo. Two ways to switch MNP One-Stop If your current carrier takes part in MNP One-Stop (most major carriers and their sub-brands do), you do not need a reservation number. You log in to your current carrier during the Kumo application to confirm the switch. Cannot be used when the contract holder changes at the same time, or for corporate contracts. MNP reservation number Get a 10-digit MNP reservation number from your current carrier (online or by phone). It is valid for 15 days including the day it is issued. To apply online, at least 10 days must remain. At a shop, at least 5 days must remain. Steps Check your phone works with Kumo Most phones sold in Japan since 2021 are SIM-unlocked and work on Kumo. Check the model in the device list in My Kumo. If your phone is locked, ask your current carrier to unlock it (usually free online). Check One-Stop, or get an MNP reservation number If you are using a reservation number, note the number and its expiry date. Apply Online: apply in My Kumo between 9:00 and 21:00. Admin fee ¥0. You need an ID document that can be read online (My Number card or driver's licence). At a shop: admin fee ¥3,850. Allow about 90 minutes. Book an appointment . Receive your SIM card or eSIM SIM cards are delivered in 2 to 4 days (Tsukimi Town and Shiose Village: add 1 day). For eSIM, the setup screen appears in My Kumo when your application is approved, usually within 1 hour. Switch your line In My Kumo, press "Switch my line". Between 9:00 and 20:00 the switch finishes in about 15 minutes. If you press it after 20:00, it is completed after 9:00 the next morning. During the switch you cannot make calls with either carrier. At a shop, staff switch the line for you. Set up your phone and make a test call Insert the SIM card ( how to ) or set up the eSIM ( how to ). Call 111 (free test number) to check. What to bring to a shop An ID document of the new contract holder ( accepted documents ) Your MNP reservation number (unless you use One-Stop) A bank cash card or credit card in the contract holder's name for monthly payment Your phone, if you keep using it, with its passcode Under 18: parental consent form (K-05) and the parent's ID. See contracts for minors If the current contract is in someone else's name For example, your phone is in a parent's name and you want the Kumo contract in your own name. The name at Kumo must normally match the name of the current contract. You can choose: Change the contract holder at your current carrier first, then switch to Kumo in your own name. Switch in your parent's name, then transfer the contract to yourself at Kumo (¥3,850). See Transfer a contract . Switch with a change of holder (shop only, family members only). Bring all of the following: Your ID document (you become the new contract holder) The current contract holder's ID document. If they cannot come with you, a copy of it and form K-12 signed by them Form K-12 "Consent to switch with change of contract holder" If your surname or address is different from theirs, a family register or certificate of residence issued within the last 3 months The MNP reservation number, obtained by the current contract holder (One-Stop cannot be used) Option 3 is not available online. The admin fee is ¥3,850; there is no separate transfer fee. Forms: Forms and downloads . An eSIM is a SIM built into your phone. You download your Kumo profile instead of inserting a card. Before you start Connect the phone to Wi-Fi. The eSIM cannot be downloaded over the mobile network you are replacing. Check that your phone supports eSIM and is SIM-unlocked. Have the eSIM setup screen open in My Kumo on another device (a computer or tablet), or use the My Kumo app on the phone itself. The QR code in My Kumo is valid for 30 days and can be used only once. iPhone Android Open Settings Go to Settings → Mobile Service → Add eSIM . Choose "Use QR code" Scan the QR code shown in My Kumo. If you are using the My Kumo app on the iPhone, tap "Install eSIM on this iPhone" instead. Wait for activation This takes 1 to 5 minutes. Do not close Settings. Label your line If you have two lines, choose which line is used for calls and mobile data. Check the connection Turn on 5G Auto in Mobile Data Options. Call 111 (free test number). Moving to a new iPhone? Use eSIM Quick Transfer during setup of the new iPhone. No reissue is needed. Open Settings Go to Settings → Network & internet → SIMs → Add SIM (on some models: Connections → SIM manager → Add eSIM). Choose "Download a SIM instead?" Scan the QR code shown in My Kumo. t: Beware of scam text messages pretending to be Kumo Mobile
x: Fake text messages (SMS) that pretend to come from Kumo Mobile are increasing. In September 2026 we received 3,412 reports from customers, 40% more than in August. The messages lead to fake websites that steal your Kumo ID, password and card details. Examples of scam messages Kumo Mobile Today 9:41 [Kumo Mobile] Your payment could not be confirmed. Your line will be suspended today. Pay now: https://kumo-mobl-pay.com/u8x +81 80-XXXX-2231 Yesterday 18:02 Your Kumo account has been locked because of unusual activity. Arrange redelivery: https://kumo-sim-delivery.info These are real examples reported to us, with links altered. Do not visit these addresses. Kumo will never ask for your password, PIN or card number by SMS or email suspend your line by SMS on the same day without first sending a payment slip (see late payments ) ask you to install an app from a link in a message Fake messages can appear in the same conversation as real messages from Kumo, because senders can fake the sender name. Always open My Kumo from a bookmark or the official app, not from a link. If you entered your details Change your Kumo ID password in My Kumo straight away. If you entered card details, call your card company to stop the card. Call Technical Support (0120-58-0234) to check for unknown purchases or SIM reissues on your line. For advice, contact the police consultation line (#9110). Protect yourself Security Pack (¥440/month, first 31 days free) filters most known scam messages and warns you about scam calls. x: Kumo's 3G network will close at the end of 31 March 2027 , so that we can use the radio frequencies for 4G and 5G. About 41,000 customers still use phones that need 3G (September 2026). Who is affected Device After 31 March 2027 3G-only phones (mainly feature phones sold until 2016) Cannot make calls, send SMS or use data 4G phones without VoLTE (4G voice) Data works, but voice calls cannot be made or received Other devices using 3G (some alarm and watch devices, older tablets) Stop working 4G phones with VoLTE and all 5G phones Not affected Check your phone in My Kumo (Contract → Device → 3G check) or call the Information Center (0120-58-0158). Customers with an affected device receive a letter in October 2026 and a reminder in January 2027. Free replacement offer Customers using an affected device can change to a designated 4G phone (Kumo Simple Phone K2) or a designated smartphone for ¥0. The shop admin fee (¥3,850) is waived for the device change until 31 March 2027. You can keep your phone number and email address. Timeline Date What happens October 2026 Letters to affected customers January 2027 Reminder letters and SMS 31 March 2027 3G service ends at midnight; replacement offer ends 1 April 2027 Lines still on 3G-era plans are changed to Kumo Mini (or Kumo 65+ if the registered user is 65 or over) If you take no action, your contract will continue and the plan fee will be charged from April 2027, even though a 3G-only phone will no longer work. Plans and prices (8) Discounts (6) Switching and new contracts (7) eSIM and SIM cards (5) Bills and payment (7) Lost phones and repairs (5) Changes and cancellation (5) Network and travel (5) My Kumo and shops (3) Plans and prices What is the cheapest plan? Kumo Mini at ¥2,178 a month (3 GB). For users aged 65 and over, Kumo 65+ (¥2,728) includes 5 GB and free calls up to 10 minutes. Which plan is cheapest depends on how much data you use: see the price chart . Can I keep data I did not use? On Kumo Basic, unused data (up to 20 GB) carries over to the next month only. On other plans it expires at the end of the month. Kumo Basic What happens when I run out of data? Your speed is limited (300 kbps on Kumo Mini and Kumo 65+, 1 Mbps on Kumo Basic) until the 1st of the next month. You can buy extra data: 1 GB ¥550, 5 GB ¥2,200. Extra data How does the Kumo Unlimited low-use discount work? If you use 3 GB or less in a month, ¥1,650 is taken off automatically. Tethering and roaming data count towards the 3 GB. Kumo Unlimited Is there a minimum contract period or a cancellation fee? No. All plans can be cancelled at any time with no cancellation fee, but the plan fee for the month you cancel is charged in full. Cancel your contract Do prices include tax? Yes. All prices include consumption tax (10%). The universal service fee (¥3) and telephone relay service fee (¥1) are added to each line every month. Is Kumo Unlimited going up in price? Yes. From 1 December 2026 it will be ¥7,458 a month. Read the notice Can someone under 65 use Kumo 65+? The registered user must be 65 or over. The contract holder (who pays) can be younger, for example a son or daughter. Kumo 65+ Discounts Who counts as family for the family discount? Relatives within the third degree of kinship (including spouses and registered partners) and people living at the same address. Up to 10 lines. Family discount Does a Kumo Mini line get the family discount? No, but it counts towards the number of lines in your group, so it can increase the discount on the other lines. When does the family discount start? With the bill for the month after the group is registered or a line joins. It is not applied to the month of registration. Can I combine the family discount, the home internet bundle and the under-22 discount? Yes. The under-22 discount is available only on Kumo Basic and Kumo Unlimited. Compare plans My child is turning 22. When does the under-22 discount end? It applies up to and including the bill for the month in which the user turns 22. Under-22 discount What happens to my family's discount if I cancel my line? The other lines' discount is recalculated from the next month. For example, if a group of 3 becomes 2, Kumo Basic lines go from ¥1,100 off to ¥550 off. Cancel your contract Switching and new contracts How long does switching to Kumo take? Online: the SIM arrives in 2–4 days and the switch itself takes about 15 minutes (9:00–20:00). eSIM can be the same day. At a shop: about 90 minutes. Switch to Kumo My MNP reservation number expires in 6 days. Can I still apply? Not online (at least 10 days must remain), but you can at a shop (at least 5 days must remain). Or get a new number from your current carrier. My phone contract is in my parent's name. Can I switch to Kumo in my own name? Yes, in three ways: change the holder at your current carrier first, switch in your parent's name and transfer at Kumo, or switch with a change of holder at a shop (with form K-12). Details and what to bring Can a 15-year-old have a contract in their own name? Yes, at a shop, with parental consent form K-05; the parent must come with their ID. Under 12, the contract must be in the parent's name. Contracts for minors Which ID documents are accepted? My Number card, driver's licence, residence card, disability certificates and more. A passport needs a supplementary document. Accepted ID documents Can I use my health insurance card as ID? No. Old-style health insurance cards are no longer accepted since 1 July 2026. A health insurance eligibility certificate is accepted with a supplementary document. Can I apply online at any time? Applications in My Kumo are accepted from 9:00 to 21:00 every day. eSIM and SIM cards How do I move my eSIM to a new phone? Use eSIM Quick Transfer (iPhone) or quick transfer (Android 14 or later on selected models). Otherwise reissue your eSIM in My Kumo for free. eSIM setup I deleted my eSIM by mistake. Reissue it in My Kumo (free, 9:00–21:00) or at a shop (¥3,850). What size is the Kumo SIM card? Nano SIM. Do not use adapters or cut cards. Insert a SIM card I have no signal after inserting the SIM. Restart the phone, check airplane mode and the APN (kumo.jp). If you switched from another carrier, check that you pressed "Switch my line" in My Kumo. Troubleshooting The eSIM QR code does not work. The code is valid for 30 days and can be used once. Connect to Wi-Fi first. If it has expired or was used, reissue the eSIM in My Kumo. Bills and payment When is my bill paid? On the 26th of the month after the usage month (next business day if the 26th is a weekend or bank holiday). Card payments follow your card company's schedule. Billing dates Why is my first bill different from the plan price? In the first month, the plan fee is charged by the day, and a shop admin fee (¥3,850) may be included. How do I stop paying the paper bill fee? Switch to the web bill in My Kumo. The ¥209 fee is not charged for Kumo 65+ or for disability certificate holders. I changed my payment method. When does it apply? Changes made by the 20th apply to that month's charge; changes after the 20th apply from the next month. What happens if I pay late? A late payment charge of 14.5% a year is added, and if the bill is unpaid 20 days after the payment slip's due date the line is suspended. Late payments What are the universal service fee and telephone relay service fee? Fees charged by all carriers in Japan (¥3 and ¥1 a month per line) to fund basic telephone services. How to read your bill Can I pay at a convenience store? Yes, with a payment slip (¥220 per slip). Lost phones and repairs My phone was stolen. What should I do first? Suspend your line: in My Kumo from another device, or call 0120-58-0110 (24 hours). Then report to the police. Lost or stolen phone Do I still pay my plan while my line is suspended? Yes. The plan fee and options continue; no call or data charges are made. I found my phone. How do I resume my line? If you suspended it in My Kumo, resume it there. If you suspended it by phone, you cannot resume online: call the Lost and Stolen line again or visit a shop with your ID. How much does a screen repair cost? With Device Care: ¥5,500 (Light), ¥3,300 (Standard), ¥0 for the first claim on Premium. Without Device Care: ¥19,800–¥42,900. Repair and replacement Can I join Device Care for a phone I bought elsewhere? Yes, Light or Standard, within 14 days of activation after a free inspection at a Kumo shop. Device Care Changes and cancellation If I cancel on the 10th, am I charged for the whole month? Yes. The plan fee and options for the month of cancellation are charged in full. Cancel your contract Do I get a refund for unused data when I cancel? No. Unused data, extra data and roaming passes are not refunded. How do I transfer my contract to my child? At a shop, with form K-15 and both IDs. The fee is ¥3,850, paid by the new holder. Transfer a contract When does a plan change take effect? From the 1st of the next month. When moving to a larger plan you can choose "Start today" until the 25th. Change your plan Can I change my plan more than once a month? Only one change applies per month: the last request made before the deadline. Network and travel Is there 5G in Tsukimi Onsen? Mostly 4G at present (5G population coverage in Tsukimi Town is 61.2%). 5G along the Kagami Line towards Tsukimi Onsen is planned by March 2027. Coverage and 5G Will my old phone work after 3G ends? 3G-only phones and 4G phones without VoLTE will not be able to make calls after 31 March 2027. 3G service end How much does data cost abroad? A 24-hour Kumo World pass costs from ¥980 (Asia). Kumo Unlimited includes 2 GB a month free in Asia and North America. International roaming Is there a limit on roaming charges on a cruise ship? No. On ships and aircraft there is no daily cap on pay-as-you-go data. Turn off data roaming on board. 5G is slow near Harukawa Central Station today. Is there a problem? Yes, an incident affecting 5G data around Harukawa Central Station is being investigated. Service status My Kumo and shops I forgot my My Kumo password. Press "Forgot password" on the login screen and enter the code sent by SMS to your Kumo phone. If your phone is lost, visit a shop with your ID. About My Kumo Do I need an appointment at a shop? No, but without one you may wait 60–90 minutes on weekend afternoons. Book an appointment Is the Harukawa Central shop open during the Lantern Festival? Yes, until 21:00 on 10 and 11 October 2026.
